Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly derived the birth year by subtracting age-at-death from the death year (2023 − 53 = 1970) and then proposed “3 December 1970,” ignoring that multiple credible sources (IMDb and tibet.columbia.edu) indicate 3 December 1969 and that age 53 at death on 8 May 2023 is fully consistent with a December 1969 birth. This flawed reconciliation and instruction to prefer 1970 introduced the wrong solution.
